# GitHub Actions Output Formatter

## Context

Bivvy runs in CI environments but currently emits plain text output. GitHub Actions supports [workflow commands](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/workflow-commands-for-github-actions) like `::error::`, `::warning::`, `::notice::`, and `::group::`/`::endgroup::` that create structured annotations and collapsible log groups. Adding a dedicated formatter will give Bivvy users rich CI feedback (error annotations on PRs, collapsible step logs) with zero configuration.

## Plan

### 1. Add `is_github_actions()` helper

**File:** `src/shell/platform.rs` (modify), `src/shell/mod.rs` (modify export)

Add a focused detection function alongside existing `is_ci()`:
```rust
pub fn is_github_actions() -> bool {
    std::env::var("GITHUB_ACTIONS").is_ok()
}
```
Export from `src/shell/mod.rs`.

---

### 2. Add `--format` global CLI flag

**File:** `src/cli/args.rs`

Add to `Cli` struct:
```rust
/// Output format for CI integration (e.g., github-actions)
#[arg(long, global = true, value_name = "FORMAT")]
pub format: Option<String>,
```

---

### 3. Create `GitHubActionsUI` implementation

**File:** `src/ui/github_actions.rs` (new)

A new `UserInterface` implementation following the `NonInteractiveUI` pattern:

| Trait method | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `error()` | `::error::{msg}` to stderr |
| `warning()` | `::warning::{msg}` to stderr |
| `success()` | `::notice::{msg}` to stdout |
| `message()` | Plain stdout (avoids annotation noise) |
| `show_hint()` | `::notice::{hint}` |
| `show_error_block()` | `::error::{command}` + plain output lines |
| `start_spinner()` | Emits `::group::{message}`, returns handle |
| `show_workflow_progress()` | No-op (progress bars are noise in logs) |
| `show_run_summary()` | Per-step `::notice::`/`::error::` + plain summary |
| `prompt()` | Same as `NonInteractiveUI` (env overrides -> defaults -> error) |
| `is_interactive()` | `false` |

**Spinner handle:** `GitHubActionsSpinnerHandle` that emits `::endgroup::` on `finish_*()` and in `Drop` (safety net for early returns/panics).

**Escaping helper:** GitHub Actions requires `%` -> `%25`, `\r` -> `%0D`, `\n` -> `%0A` in annotation messages, plus `,` -> `%2C`, `:` -> `%3A` in property values.

---

### 4. Register module and update factory

**Files:** `src/ui/mod.rs`, `src/ui/terminal.rs`

- Add `pub mod github_actions` and `pub use github_actions::GitHubActionsUI` to `src/ui/mod.rs`
- Add `create_ui_with_format(interactive, mode, format)` to `src/ui/terminal.rs`:
  - `Some("github-actions")` -> `GitHubActionsUI`
  - `None` + `GITHUB_ACTIONS` env var set -> `GitHubActionsUI` (auto-detect)
  - Otherwise -> existing `create_ui()` logic

---

### 5. Wire up in main

**File:** `src/main.rs`

Replace `create_ui(is_interactive, output_mode)` with `create_ui_with_format(is_interactive, output_mode, cli.format.as_deref())`.

---

### 6. Documentation

**File:** `src/ui/README.md`

Add a "GitHub Actions Output" section documenting the annotation mapping, auto-detection, and `--format` flag.

## Files changed

| File | Action |
|---|---|
| `src/ui/github_actions.rs` | Create |
| `src/ui/mod.rs` | Modify (add module + re-export) |
| `src/ui/terminal.rs` | Modify (add `create_ui_with_format`) |
| `src/cli/args.rs` | Modify (add `--format` flag) |
| `src/main.rs` | Modify (use new factory) |
| `src/shell/platform.rs` | Modify (add `is_github_actions()`) |
| `src/shell/mod.rs` | Modify (export `is_github_actions`) |
| `src/ui/README.md` | Modify (document new mode) |

## Verification

```bash
cargo test --all-features          # All tests pass
cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo fmt -- --check
cargo doc --no-deps --all-features
cargo build --release
```

Integration test: run `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true cargo run -- run` against a test project and verify `::group::`, `::error::`, `::notice::` appear in output.

# GitHub Actions Output Formatter

## Context

Bivvy runs in CI environments but currently emits plain text output. GitHub Actions supports [workflow commands](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/workflow-commands-for-github-actions) like `::error::`, `::warning::`, `::notice::`, and `::group::`/`::endgroup::` that create structured annotations and collapsible log groups. Adding a dedicated formatter will give Bivvy users rich CI feedback (error annotations on PRs, collapsible step logs) with zero configuration.

## Plan

### 1. Add `is_github_actions()` helper

**File:** `src/shell/platform.rs` (modify), `src/shell/mod.rs` (modify export)

Add a focused detection function alongside existing `is_ci()`:
```rust
pub fn is_github_actions() -> bool {
    std::env::var("GITHUB_ACTIONS").is_ok()
}
```
Export from `src/shell/mod.rs`.

---

### 2. Add `--format` global CLI flag

**File:** `src/cli/args.rs`

Add to `Cli` struct:
```rust
/// Output format for CI integration (e.g., github-actions)
#[arg(long, global = true, value_name = "FORMAT")]
pub format: Option<String>,
```

---

### 3. Create `GitHubActionsUI` implementation

**File:** `src/ui/github_actions.rs` (new)

A new `UserInterface` implementation following the `NonInteractiveUI` pattern:

| Trait method | Behavior |
|---|---|
| `error()` | `::error::{msg}` to stderr |
| `warning()` | `::warning::{msg}` to stderr |
| `success()` | `::notice::{msg}` to stdout |
| `message()` | Plain stdout (avoids annotation noise) |
| `show_hint()` | `::notice::{hint}` |
| `show_error_block()` | `::error::{command}` + plain output lines |
| `start_spinner()` | Emits `::group::{message}`, returns handle |
| `show_workflow_progress()` | No-op (progress bars are noise in logs) |
| `show_run_summary()` | Per-step `::notice::`/`::error::` + plain summary |
| `prompt()` | Same as `NonInteractiveUI` (env overrides -> defaults -> error) |
| `is_interactive()` | `false` |

**Spinner handle:** `GitHubActionsSpinnerHandle` that emits `::endgroup::` on `finish_*()` and in `Drop` (safety net for early returns/panics).

**Escaping helper:** GitHub Actions requires `%` -> `%25`, `\r` -> `%0D`, `\n` -> `%0A` in annotation messages, plus `,` -> `%2C`, `:` -> `%3A` in property values.

---

### 4. Register module and update factory

**Files:** `src/ui/mod.rs`, `src/ui/terminal.rs`

- Add `pub mod github_actions` and `pub use github_actions::GitHubActionsUI` to `src/ui/mod.rs`
- Add `create_ui_with_format(interactive, mode, format)` to `src/ui/terminal.rs`:
  - `Some("github-actions")` -> `GitHubActionsUI`
  - `None` + `GITHUB_ACTIONS` env var set -> `GitHubActionsUI` (auto-detect)
  - Otherwise -> existing `create_ui()` logic

---

### 5. Wire up in main

**File:** `src/main.rs`

Replace `create_ui(is_interactive, output_mode)` with `create_ui_with_format(is_interactive, output_mode, cli.format.as_deref())`.

---

### 6. Documentation

**File:** `src/ui/README.md`

Add a "GitHub Actions Output" section documenting the annotation mapping, auto-detection, and `--format` flag.

| `src/ui/github_actions.rs` | Create |
| `src/ui/mod.rs` | Modify (add module + re-export) |
| `src/ui/terminal.rs` | Modify (add `create_ui_with_format`) |
| `src/cli/args.rs` | Modify (add `--format` flag) |
| `src/main.rs` | Modify (use new factory) |
| `src/shell/platform.rs` | Modify (add `is_github_actions()`) |
| `src/shell/mod.rs` | Modify (export `is_github_actions`) |
